---
name: run-tracking
description: Keep a progress log in your run folder and end it with a handover
---
Append short progress notes to `log.md` in your run folder as you work. When you finish, or when asked for a handover, end the file with:

    ## Handover
    done: ...
    open: ...
    next: ...
    <!-- lm:end status=done|failed|handover -->
